title: Record number format
description: A number format document (ADR-005 §3.1, §3.5, §3.6). The template grammar, the leading-{prefix} rule, grow ambiguity and the 64-character rendering bound are checked by numbering.CompileFormat in Go; this schema bounds the shape only.

template.description: Literal runs of [A-Z0-9_/.-] and the tokens {prefix}, {yyyy}, {yy}, {MM}, {dd} and exactly one {seq:N}, 1 <= N <= 12. Starts with {prefix}.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone name the date parts are read in. Absent or empty means the tenant's time_zone setting.
